entities.summary: A woman searches for her missing half sister Marla Chen, while a journalist investigates a mysterious tape involving 'Deaders' and a ritual, both drawn into a disturbing, interconnected mystery with personal stakes.

entities.name: Lighter
entities.description: A handheld device used by Amy to produce light in the dark tunnel; becomes hot during use and requires insulation with a handkerchief.
entities.summary: A handheld device used by Amy to produce light in the dark tunnel; becomes hot during use and requires insulation with a handkerchief.

entities.name: handkerchief
entities.description: A piece of fabric used by Amy to insulate the hot lighter, allowing her to handle it safely in the dark tunnel.

entities.name: roaches
entities.description: A swarm of insects inhabiting the tunnel that scatter when exposed to light from Amy's lighter.

entities.name: Amy passes the lighter over her head in the narrow tunnel
entities.description: Unable to bring her hands together in front of her due to the tight space, Amy reaches up and transfers the lighter from one hand to the other over her head, nearly dropping it in the process.

entities.name: Lighter goes out as Amy struggles in confined space
entities.description: During the transfer of the lighter over her head, it slips from Amy's grasp and extinguishes, plunging her into near-total darkness.

entities.name: Amy reignites the lighter after momentary failure
entities.description: After the lighter goes out and fails to ignite on the second strike, Amy successfully reignites it on the next attempt, restoring light to the tunnel.

entities.name: Light reveals knife-wielding figure in the tunnel with Amy
entities.description: When the lighter reignites, its flickering flame illuminates a mysterious figure on the far side of Amy’s body, holding a knife, unseen by Amy but visible to the audience.

entities.name: Amy retreats backward through the tunnel with limited visibility
entities.description: Facing away from her direction of movement, Amy begins crawling backward through the narrowing passage, using the lighter to illuminate the unseen path ahead.

entities.name: Tunnel walls close in on Amy, trapping her completely
entities.description: As Amy attempts to move backward, the walls of the tunnel progressively narrow until they press tightly against her body, immobilizing her and restricting her breathing.

entities.name: Amy twists her head to face the knife-wielding figure
entities.description: Trapped and sensing danger, Amy exerts extreme physical effort to turn her head around and comes face to face with the figure holding a knife poised to strike.

entities.name: Knife slashes toward Amy, narrowly missing her arm
entities.description: The knife-wielding figure thrusts the blade forward in an attack that slices through the air just beside Amy's arm, causing her to scream and drop the lighter.

entities.name: Amy drops the lighter and flees into deeper darkness
entities.description: After the knife attack narrowly misses, Amy releases the lighter in terror and scrambles frantically deeper into the dark, confined space.

entities.name: Amy panics and struggles to escape the closing walls
entities.description: With rising panic, Amy flails, climbs, crouches, and pulls in all directions trying to free herself from the tightening walls, but her movements are severely restricted.

entities.name: Knife-wielding figure advances on trapped Amy
entities.description: Despite the tight space, the mysterious figure continues to move closer to Amy, struggling but determined, raising the knife for a final attack.

entities.name: Amy pleads with the attacker to stop the assault
entities.description: In desperation, Amy cries out, begging the approaching figure to cease the attack as she is pinned and defenseless.

entities.name: Amy's hand strikes wall behind her during frantic escape attempt
entities.description: While flailing in panic, one of Amy's hands hits the solid wall behind her, confirming there is no escape route in that direction and intensifying her terror.

entities.name: Amy discovers no escape route along the tunnel wall
entities.description: After desperately scraping her hands along the wall in search of an opening, Amy realizes there is no way out, heightening her sense of entrapment.

entities.name: knife-wielding figure
entities.description: An unseen individual in the tunnel who confronts Amy with a knife, advancing on her as she becomes trapped.

entities.name: knife
entities.description: A bladed weapon held by the figure in the tunnel, used to threaten and attack Amy.

document_metadata.title: 25、INT. THE BATHROOM - DAY
document_metadata.summary: Amy avoids the crowd, notices the Black Kid's slashed wrists, and is guided by him and the naked revived man to a shadowed doorway where Winter has gone.

entities.name: Amy falls backward onto the floor in fear
entities.description: After a confrontation, Amy loses her balance and falls onto the floor, experiencing intense physical symptoms of fear including a pounding heart and heavy breathing.

entities.name: Amy checks her arms for wounds
entities.description: Amy inspects her arms for injuries after a traumatic incident, finding none despite her expectation of harm.

entities.name: Amy discovers the Figure has disappeared
entities.description: Amy looks up from the floor and realizes that the mysterious Figure she was facing is no longer present in the room.

entities.name: Amy stands up and surveys the empty room
entities.description: Amy rises from the floor, disoriented, and takes in her surroundings, noticing debris and the absence of any visible entry point.

entities.name: Amy nearly trips while fleeing the entry area
entities.description: In an attempt to escape the area near the entrance, Amy stumbles over a piece of rubble, indicating her panic and the hazardous environment.

entities.name: Amy hears a sharp exhalation and searches for its source
entities.description: Amy detects the sound of someone breathing sharply and turns around quickly, scanning the room to locate the unseen source.

entities.name: A young Black kid appears and signals silence
entities.description: A young Black boy steps into a pale light, places a finger to his lips to signal silence, and indicates that Amy should follow him.

entities.name: Amy cautiously follows the young Black kid into an adjoining room
entities.description: Amy moves forward with caution, following the young boy from the previous room into an adjacent space with partially destroyed walls.

entities.name: Amy observes a group gathered around a figure on the floor
entities.description: From the shadows, Amy peers through a gap in the wall and sees a group of people, some recognizable from a videotape, crowded around an object or person on the floor.

entities.name: Amy sees Katya with a head wound inspecting her own blood
entities.description: Amy identifies Katya among the group and watches her touch the hole in her head and examine the blood on her finger.

entities.name: Winter performs resuscitation on a young man's corpse
entities.description: Winter is seen breathing into the mouth of a dead young man in a manner similar to a prior ritual, producing a supernatural effect.

entities.name: The young man gasps back to life with a knife in his chest
entities.description: After Winter's resuscitation, the young man suddenly inhales sharply and awakens, smiling despite a knife embedded in his chest.

entities.name: Winter removes the knife from the young man's chest
entities.description: Winter pulls the knife out of the young man's chest after he has been revived, marking the completion of the ritual.

entities.name: Others assist the revived young man to his feet
entities.description: Members of the group step forward to help the newly revived young man stand up after his resurrection.

entities.name: Someone places a robe on Winter
entities.description: After completing the ritual, Winter is given a robe by one of the participants, which he wears as he prepares to leave.

entities.name: Winter addresses Amy from across the room
entities.description: Despite Amy being hidden in the shadows, Winter directly speaks to her, acknowledging her presence and inviting her to join him.

entities.name: Winter throws a knife into the wall with unnatural force
entities.description: Winter hurls a knife at the wall, where it embeds much deeper than physically plausible, demonstrating supernatural strength or power.

entities.name: Secret Resurrection Ritual Gathering
entities.description: A clandestine, organized event in which a group of individuals performs a supernatural ritual to revive the dead, involving specific actions, participants, and a structured sequence of events.

entities.name: adjoining room
entities.description: A room connected to the empty room, with partially torn-down walls and a source of pale light, where a group is gathered around a figure on the floor.

entities.name: gap in the wall

entities.name: shadows

entities.name: Amy Klein
entities.description: A woman who experiences fear and confusion upon discovering a secret gathering where resurrection rituals are performed, and who cautiously observes the events from the shadows.
entities.summary: A woman searches for her missing half sister Marla Chen, while a journalist investigates a mysterious tape involving 'Deaders' and a ritual, both drawn into a disturbing, interconnected mystery with personal stakes.

entities.name: Winter
entities.description: A central figure in the resurrection ritual who performs life-restoring acts on corpses, displays supernatural strength, and directly addresses Amy from across the room.
entities.summary: A ritual leader commands silence during Katya's initiation; a man shows emotional attachment to her corpse; another with Marla holds a puzzle box; a young man with glasses is sought with Katya; a trench-coated man stares at Amy before dying by train.

entities.name: young Black kid
entities.description: A young individual who appears in the dim light, signals silence to Amy, and guides her into an adjoining room where a ritual is taking place.

entities.name: Katya
entities.description: A woman with a head wound who is present among the group, inspecting her own blood, and recognized by Amy from prior footage.
entities.summary: A young girl with dark hair is introduced nervously, while a red-haired girl is sought on a train. A woman with a head wound appears in footage and among the group, recognized by Amy. Another woman undergoes a ritual, and a deceased woman lies on a mattress, central to a post-mortem rite.

entities.name: young man
entities.description: A corpse revived by Winter through resuscitation, who gasps back to life with a knife in his chest and is then assisted by others.

entities.name: Knife
entities.description: A blade used in the resurrection ritual, initially lodged in the young man's chest, removed by Winter, and later thrown into the wall with unnatural force.
entities.summary: Multiple blades appear across events: one used in a resurrection ritual and removed from a young man; another physically and psychologically tormenting Amy; a stiletto used in ritual and defiance; and a blade seized by Amy as a tool of resistance, central to her final act.

entities.name: Amy attempts to avoid physical contact with the gathering participants
entities.description: As Amy moves through the room, she hesitates and tries to evade the close proximity of the occupants, who subtly encroach upon her personal space without overt aggression.

entities.description: The young Black kid approaches Amy, places a hand on her shoulder, gestures, and points toward a shadowy doorway indicating Winter's location.

entities.name: Amy notices deep slash wounds on Black Kid's wrists
entities.description: Amy observes that the Black Kid's pointing hand bears deep lacerations on the wrists, and she examines the other hand he offers for inspection.

entities.name: Amy backs away through the crowd followed by the revived young man
entities.description: Amy retreats through the group of participants, with the recently revived young man, still naked, following closely behind her with a smile.

document_metadata.title: 46、INT. PSYCH WARD/COMMON AREA - DAY
document_metadata.summary: Marla reveals Amy is the chosen one who can solve the puzzle tied to trauma, emphasizing a mysterious figure's crucial role for her survival, then vanishes as Amy notices she's bleeding and the room empties.

entities.name: Amy enters psychiatric ward and observes other patients
entities.description: Amy cautiously enters a room filled with patients who are preoccupied with their own activities and imaginary companions, feeling uneasy and searching for a place to sit.

entities.name: Amy approaches a little girl drawing in the corner
entities.description: Amy notices a young girl sitting alone creating drawings, some of which depict disturbing imagery, and walks over to join her.

entities.name: Little girl offers to draw Amy's portrait
entities.description: The little girl invites Amy to let her draw her picture, which Amy accepts with interest, noting the apparent quality and care in the girl's artwork.

entities.name: Little girl draws Amy's portrait with unnatural skill
entities.description: The girl begins drawing with precise, adult-like hand movements that contrast with her apparent age, refusing to let Amy see the work in progress.

entities.name: Little girl reveals portrait of Amy as a Cenobite
entities.description: The completed drawing shows Amy's face grotesquely transformed into a Cenobite, with distorted features, exposed skull, and a chest wound with hooks, horrifying Amy when she sees it.

entities.name: Amy reacts with terror upon seeing her portrait
entities.description: Amy recoils in fear and begins trembling after viewing the disturbing image, realizing it depicts her as a monstrous figure from the Hellraiser universe.

entities.name: Little girl claims to draw only what she sees
entities.description: The little girl states cryptically that she only draws what she perceives, implying she sees Amy's future or true form as a Cenobite.

entities.name: Amy discovers other drawings depict Cenobites and Deaders
entities.description: Amy examines the girl's previous drawings on the wall and recognizes them as depictions of Cenobites, Deaders, and a figure resembling Winter, all in monstrous forms.

entities.description: Amy walks over to Marla, visibly uncertain and emotionally conflicted upon seeing her alive and seemingly unrecognizing.

document_metadata.summary: Charles meets a reporter as news covers a Bucharest explosion; a puzzle box survives, and a photo of him and Amy evokes a rare, peaceful smile, hinting at closure.
